# Wordsmyth

> > Wordsmyth provides comprehensive English language learning tools including dictionaries, thesaurus, writing analysis, and educational resources for learners of all ages.

Wordsmyth is a dedicated platform for English language learners, offering both digital tools for vocabulary and writing improvement, as well as physical educational resources through their shop. The site features the WILD (Wordsmyth Illustrated Learner's Dictionary) and advanced readability analysis powered by multiple linguistic metrics.

## Key Topics

- English language learning
- Vocabulary tools
- Dictionary and thesaurus
- Readability analysis
- Writing tools
- Readability metrics (Flesch-Kincaid, SMOG, Gunning-Fog, Coleman-Liau, ARI)
- Text analysis
- Educational resources
- Kids learning
- Teacher tools
- Synonym and antonym learning
- WILD: Wordsmyth Illustrated Learner's Dictionary

## Core Learning Tools

- [Wordsmyth Dictionary & Thesaurus](https://www.wordsmyth.net): Wordsmyth English dictionary and thesaurus designed specifically for language learners with comprehensive word definitions and synonyms
- [Text Highlighter & Writing Analysis](https://www.wordsmyth.net/text_highlighter): Advanced writing tool with readability analysis, text metrics, and automated readability indices (Flesch-Kincaid, SMOG, Gunning-Fog, Coleman-Liau, ARI) for improving writing quality

## Educational Resources

- [Wordsmyth Shop](https://shop.wordsmyth.net/): Educational books and learning resources for kids, including vocabulary activity books and learning materials

## Optional

- [Synonyms and Antonyms Activity Book](https://shop.wordsmyth.net/product/synonyms-antonyms-activity-book/): Interactive activity book focusing on synonyms and antonyms vocabulary learning for students
